description: Expander for MIDI-CAT, placed immediately to the right of it, adding four clocks that hold incoming MIDI back until the next beat.

inputs.text: A trigger applies the MIDI messages buffered since the previous trigger to the parameters assigned to this clock.

notes: the expander carries no menu of its own; a slot is quantized from MIDI-CAT's mapping slot menu, which shows the CLK-expander section once this module is attached.
menu: Quantization — on a MIDI-CAT mapping slot's own right-click menu, under CLK-expander: Off, On (instant feedback), or On (deferred feedback), which sends the reply on the clock trigger.
Source — on a MIDI-CAT mapping slot's own right-click menu, under CLK-expander: Clock 1 to Clock 4, choosing which of these inputs holds that slot back.

inputs.0: high above 1V · stepped · one channel only
